english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for something ending or for bringing a meeting, speech, or activity to an end.
Use this when someone deliberately ends an activity or when an event is being formally concluded.
Use this when a period, event, or process comes to an end rather than when an item becomes invalid.
Use this when a meeting, session, event, or other activity is being brought to an end.

examples.english: We can conclude the meeting now.
examples.traditional: 我哋而家可以結束會議喇。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 ho2 ji5 git3 cuk1 wui6 ji5 laa3

examples.english: We will end the meeting at five.
examples.jyutping: wui5 ji5 dou3 ng5 dim2 zau6 git3 cuk1

examples.english: The trial period will expire at the end of the month.
examples.traditional: 個試用期去到月底就結束喇。
examples.jyutping: go3 si3 jung6 kei4 heoi3 dou3 jyut6 dai2 zau6 git3 cuk1 laa3

examples.english: The lecture will close at five.
examples.jyutping: go3 gong2 zo6 ng5 dim2 zau6 git3 cuk1
